mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism activates whenever the rate trend is downward.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 6.0% indicates tightening labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE is below 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary regime (CPIAUCSL > 240), high inflation pressures prompt Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240, or Rank IC for signal falls below -0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production signals expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP exceeding 16000 billion dollars reflects strong economic growth that boosts corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 16000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment and declining unemployment rates signal labor market tightness that enhances consumer spending and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 900 thousand units), rising housing starts indicate improving consumer confidence and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when HOUST exceeds 900, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.
